note: Decision scope (D232, D233; supersedes signed D204 T4/T5 currently on origin/main superseding previous 1.0 m / 1.5 to sensitivity). Written on 2026-11-15 by an AI session to follow D232 and D233 of issue #77 (https://github.com/gbarbozamar/field-shift-rotation-twin/issues/77#issuecomment-6893254289), taken by the orchestrating AI session under the delegation of D161. Following executive sign-off, 1.0 m becomes the sensitivity, as D204 did for soybean. Load one wheat height only: both records share id and scope. WHAT IS LOCAL: the value, the mean of 16 campaign means of plant height at La Estanzuela, sowing period 1, intermediate cycle, 2010-2025 (83.9-106.2 cm). WHAT IS CHOSEN: one final height for the whole cycle (the limit declared in D204; FAO-56 asks for the mean maximum height of each period, chapter 7, symbols of Eq. 72), and the intermediate cycle and sowing period 1 as the match for the D72 sowing date. LIMIT: the height includes the awns (sheet «INICIO», row 34), so it is somewhat above the canopy height. CONTEXT: the value lies inside the updated standard range for common wheat, 0.70-1.10 m (Pereira et al. 2021, Agric. Water Manag. 243:106466, Table 15). ARITHMETIC: 92.95 cm / 100 = 0.9295 m, rounded to 0.93 m. D233: rows by trial code containing «LE1»; the 109 rows of the 2014 trials at Young labelled La Estanzuela (Excel rows 2112-2220) are excluded. Values are cited; the file is not redistributed.
